dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: When Mr. Thoma first came to the Kamisato Clan, people suspected him on account of his being an outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: But from my observations, Mr. Thoma is steady and friendly — and he is a truly reliable fellow.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: I mean, why else would he be the trusted assistant of the Commissioner and Miss Kamisato, right? Haha!
